R0_Menopause.title: Menopausal status at baseline
R0_Menopause.x-derivation: Variable uses questionnaire variable. Derived from: AgeEntry, R0_EverHadPeriods, R0_PeriodsStoppedPerm, R0_HRTPeriodsUnclear, R0_MenopauseAge, R0_PeriodsStoppedReason, R0_OvaryOp_BothOvaries, R0_OvaryOp_Uterus, R0_OvaryOp_Age, R0_OvaryOp_FromAge, R0_OvaryOp_ToAge

R0_AgeMenopause.title: Age at menopause (years)
R0_AgeMenopause.x-derivation: Uses questionnaire variable as best answer, or if no answer available, variable takes into account reported operations, cancer treatments, HRT and OC use. Assumed age 51 years when menopause is masked by hysterectomy or HRT use. Derived from: AgeEntry, R0_EverHadPeriods, R0_PeriodsStoppedPerm, R0_HRTPeriodsUnclear, R0_MenopauseAge, R0_PeriodsStoppedReason, R0_OvaryOp_BothOvaries, R0_OvaryOp_Uterus, R0_OvaryOp_Age, R0_OvaryOp_FromAge, R0_OvaryOp_ToAge
R0_AgeMenopause.$comment: Legacy name: age_menopause. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.

R0_MenopauseReason.title: Reason periods stopped

oneOf.title: Chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or other cancer treatment
Does not know reason for stopping
Natural menopause while on HRT or OC
Surgery, but not oophorectomy or hysterectomy

R0_MenopauseReason.x-derivation: Uses questionnaire variable. If no other information given then answer unknown. Derived from: AgeEntry, R0_EverHadPeriods, R0_PeriodsStoppedPerm, R0_HRTPeriodsUnclear, R0_MenopauseAge, R0_PeriodsStoppedReason, R0_OvaryOp_BothOvaries, R0_OvaryOp_Uterus, R0_OvaryOp_Age, R0_OvaryOp_FromAge, R0_OvaryOp_ToAge

R0_HRTStatus.title: Menopausal hormone treatment status at baseline
R0_HRTStatus.x-derivation: From HRT episode array: any prior but stopped = Former; active at R0 (stop missing or after EntryDate) = Current; none = Never. Derived from: R0_HRT_Use, R0_HRT_StartAge, R0_HRT_StopAge, R0_HRT_CurrentUse, AgeEntry

R0_HRTStartAge.title: Age started menopausal hormone treatment
R0_HRTStartAge.x-derivation: Earliest HRT start across episodes as given in the questionnaire. Derived from: R0_HRT_StartAge
R0_HRTStartAge.$comment: Legacy name: hrt1age. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.

R0_HRTStopAge.title: Age stopped menopausal hormone treatment
R0_HRTStopAge.x-derivation: Latest HRT stop across episodes as given in the questionnaire. Derived from: R0_HRT_StopAge
R0_HRTStopAge.$comment: Legacy name: hrtlage. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.

R0_HRTDuration.title: Total duration of menopausal hormone treatment (years)
R0_HRTDuration.x-derivation: Sum merged HRT episodes (stop - start)/365.25. If overlapping, does not duplicate overlapping time. Only includes periods before recruitment, not estimating open ended times occurring during entry date. Derived from: R0_HRTStartAge, R0_HRTStopAge
R0_HRTDuration.$comment: Legacy name: hrtlength. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.
